scope: Authoring packages only; historical evidence copies, sealed stores and built artifacts are excluded from maintained library counts.

submit.does: Submit a durable build job. This acknowledges submission, not success; inspect status and result separately.

status.does: Read and reconcile the owned build attempt.

cancel.does: Request cancellation of the owned build attempt.

result.does: Read build result references; submission alone is not success.

inspect_package.does: Verify an existing sealed package and read its declared verification units and known local implementation identities; no package execution.

verify_unit.does: Apply one explicit allowlisted in-process domain invariant to saved task evidence; persist a scoped verification result.

assess_admission.does: Assess selected package capabilities against operator task policy and current verification identities; supplies no grants or runtime/scientific certification.

plan.does: Propose a fixed native Strata observer run using existing host admission and lifecycle; inspect profiler executable availability without launching them.

analyze.does: Parse scoped native DS4_PROF or Nsight CSV artifacts into phase bottleneck candidates and instrumentation gaps. Never score traced timings.

status.does: Read durable cycles, pending attempts and remaining operator budgets.

select.does: Record an agent-selected report-backed hypothesis and reserve one bounded operator-admitted experiment.

execute.does: Freeze an exact admitted template into a new child task and submit via the existing durable benchmark queue. Replay recovers the same attempt.

collect.does: Reconcile the child benchmark, retain failed or successful evidence and expose follow-up proposals for the agent's next decision.

stop.does: Persist stop intent for future experiments without cancelling already queued work.

inspect.does: Inspect an authorized source checkout, host and optional local image; publish evidence.

preflight.does: Resolve local image Id and reject unsupported flags using help cached by immutable Id.

verify_effective_config.does: Run one bounded CPU-only model config probe in an NVIDIA-runtime container and publish actual stderr evidence.

inspect_strata.does: Inspect the operator-pinned complete Strata asset inventory and fixed workload without launching a model.

plan_get.does: Read a replayable work graph, ready frontier, blocked reasons and revision history. Proposed work is a suggestion.

plan_patch.does: Apply a task-scoped work graph patch by CAS, citing a published decision. Does not start jobs or grant authority.

query.does: Query bounded task-scoped evidence summaries and cursor.

read.does: Read a task-scoped evidence record, with bounded artifact preview.

publish.does: Publish an immutable observation/artifact or compare-and-swap decision revision.

evaluate.does: Evaluate a bounded expert trace using request-separated temporal holdout, frozen frequency and causal last-token baselines. No inference execution or speed claim.

applicability.does: Inspect applicability and publish a task-scoped observation; no engine execution.

engagement.does: Inspect engagement and publish a task-scoped observation; no engine execution.

diagnose.does: Analyze retained experiment reports across inference subsystems; surface uncertainties and inspection candidates.

ablation.does: Design one-variable diagnostic or ABBA work without executing or scoring it.

followup.does: Convert report-backed uncertainty into a proposed next input; never submit or amend a contract.

cache_protocol.does: Describe a bounded out-of-core cache and phase protocol from retained evidence.

propose.does: Record an agent-authored unmeasured hypothesis linked to scoped evidence; does not fetch citations or execute experiments.

profile_plan.does: Propose a fixed native Strata observer run using existing host admission and lifecycle; inspect profiler executable availability without launching them.

analyze_profile.does: Parse scoped native DS4_PROF or Nsight CSV artifacts into phase bottleneck candidates and instrumentation gaps. Never score traced timings.

evaluate_prediction.does: Evaluate a bounded expert trace using request-separated temporal holdout, frozen frequency and causal last-token baselines. No inference execution or speed claim.

test_scope.does: Match a claim and engine layer to a scoped verification plan; advisory only, no execution authority.

submit.does: Admit an image object with exactly tag and immutable id, plus a separate build_attempt_id, and submit a fixed lab evaluation through the GPU queue. run_config may include profile nsys to trace the run with Nsight Systems; the result then carries a kernel, CUDA API and OS-runtime breakdown. Traced timing is perturbed and is never speed evidence.

status.does: Read the owned lab attempt from the durable queue.

cancel.does: Cancel the owned lab attempt and reap its container.

result.does: Read evaluation and evidence references for the owned lab attempt.

ab_submit.does: Admit both images and queue one contract-bound ABBA experiment; checks come from component materials.

ab_status.does: Read the owned durable A/B job status.

ab_result.does: Ingest and read verified A/B verdict, correctness and evidence.

status.does: Read owned Strata lifecycle and evidence state through host reconciliation.

recover.does: Reconcile a terminal owned Strata attempt and import partial failure; never terminate active or unrelated work.

ablation.does: Design one-variable diagnostic or ABBA work without executing or scoring it.

diagnose.does: Analyze retained experiment reports across inference subsystems; surface uncertainties and inspection candidates.

followup.does: Convert report-backed uncertainty into a proposed next input; never submit or amend a contract.

propose.does: Record an agent-authored unmeasured hypothesis linked to scoped evidence; does not fetch citations or execute experiments.

cache_protocol.does: Describe a bounded out-of-core cache and phase protocol from retained evidence.

submit.does: Submit the operator-frozen ARC correctness and pg512/tg128 native speed comparison. Never edits questions, policy, source pins, arm profiles or order.

status.does: Reconcile the current-task benchmark attempt with the durable GPU queue.

result.does: Independently verify raw evidence and report correctness and speed gates for a completed current-task benchmark. Partial execution is inconclusive.

apply.does: Produce a candidate changing only the native Strata positive prefill chunk size.

inspect.does: Inspect the current task's frozen prefill scope, workload and obligations without model execution.

design.does: Draft a separate screen or confirm prefill contract; no admission, contract mutation or performance claim.

apply.does: Change only the bounded native prefill chunk in a full-six static profile.

verify_profile.does: Check the requested static profile and chunk value; runtime engagement remains unmeasured.

submit.does: Submit the exact operator-admitted bounded fresh-process prefill campaign through host lifecycle and resource guards.

status.does: Read and reconcile the current task's owned scoped attempt lifecycle.

result.does: Independently verify retained raw cells and report a scoped prefill result; no full-generation quality acceptance or automatic promotion.

apply.does: Produce a candidate profile changing only native Strata dspark none/on. Does not submit work or change a contract.
